class.name: MobaMapData
class.brief_description: Editable plateau terrain and explicit ramp connections.
class.description: Stores an X/Z cell grid for [MobaMap3D]. Each cell contains a level, palette material index and ramp direction. Ramps rise across one cell toward a flat neighbour one level higher. Changes notify only the affected region. Resources are local to scene instances by default.

method.name: apply_cells
method.description: Atomically applies a Dictionary mapping Vector2i cell coordinates to Vector3i(level, material, ramp). Invalid values reject the patch. Nearby ramps with disconnected endpoints are removed.

method.name: can_place_ramp
method.description: Returns whether all cells across the width connect flat low and high plateaus. The width is centered on cell, perpendicular to direction.

method.name: contains
method.description: Returns whether a cell is inside the map.

method.name: get_cell
method.description: Returns (plateau level, material index, ramp direction), or Vector3i.ZERO outside the map.

method.name: get_cells
method.description: Returns packed triples in Z-major order. Prefer [method apply_cells] for regular edits.

method.name: get_plateau_level
method.description: Returns the base plateau level at map-local X/Z, including at ramps. Returns zero outside the map.

method.name: get_surface_height
method.description: Returns the map-local surface height, interpolated along ramps. Returns zero outside the map.

method.name: place_ramp
method.description: Places parallel ramp cells and returns true. Leaves the data unchanged when placement is invalid.

method.name: set_cell
method.description: Updates one cell. Valid ranges: level -128 to 128, material 0 to 255, and a Ramp direction.

method.name: set_cells
method.description: Replaces packed triples. Length must equal size.x * size.y * 3. Values are validated before mutation; invalidated nearby ramps are cleared.

members.member: Width and depth of each cell in world units; range 1 to 64.
Vertical distance between plateau levels; range 0.5 to 32.
Grid dimensions, 1 to 1024 on each axis. Resizing preserves overlapping cells.

signal.name: region_changed
signal.description: Emitted after source data changes. The rectangle includes removed invalid ramps.
